method: original-paint object RGBA rigs; registered bounded Orbis motion fields for herd, stag, bank bird and bathers; retained Orbis foreground bird and fire; authored wind, waterfall, floating objects, both rivers and horizon smoke
notes: New model RGB was rejected for exposure drift and weak articulation. Four generated motion fields are applied only to isolated original-paint cutouts, bounded to 2.5 pixels. Source wing and leg rigs supplement those fields. Sky, ground, buildings and camera remain anchored. Native generated loops are not claimed.
